body.text: Hard value shows up in the ledger: collected revenue, contract savings and avoided write-offs.
Capacity value is time released, valued at loaded cost and redeployed.
Risk avoided is expected loss: probability times impact.
Finance validates against the ledger; Compliance reviews the risk estimate yearly.
Tracked every quarter, never counted toward ROI or payback.
A quarterly pulse survey and decision-cycle times, reported beside the value tracker.
